meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Neuter главное, used as a noun. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('main, most important').

examples.trans: The main thing is, don't worry.
The most important thing is the people.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.text: Я уже не могу готовить, стирать, убирать. Я хочу на море!
examples.trans: I can't take the cooking, washing and cleaning any more. I want to go to the sea!

гулять.gloss: to walk, to go for a walk

meanings.en: to walk, to stroll, to be outdoors
meanings.note: Гулять с собакой = to walk the dog.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

meanings.note: Irregular plural деревья, деревьев.

meanings.en: to listen to the end, to hear out

examples.text: Он никогда не дослушивает до конца.
examples.trans: He never listens to the end.

meanings.note: Singular only.

meanings.en: to bring inside, to carry in

meanings.note: Question word and conjunction.
